title: Golden end-to-end suite case (§29)
description: One of the ten required golden queries. Wraps a full query family (validated against query_family.schema.json) with the expected end-to-end behaviour: the deterministic headline (§4.2), the archive conclusion (§4), and per-variant expectations (e.g. visible-absence assessable vs occluded, bounded-count fragmentation decoy). Fixtures are synthetic and labeled as such; expected behaviour is asserted structurally, never by invented model scores. Run cache-bypassed before every release candidate (§29).

required_index.description: Position in the §29 required list: 1 object, 2 attribute, 3 action, 4 binding, 5 cross-window order, 6 absent/no-match, 7 unobservable, 8 bounded disjunction, 9 visible absence (assessable+occluded), 10 bounded count with fragmentation decoy.

headline_contains.description: A substring that MUST appear in the deterministic headline (§4.2), e.g. 'VERIFIED MATCHES FOUND', 'NO VERIFIED MATCH', 'INSUFFICIENT VISUAL EVIDENCE'.

variants.description: Per-variant expectations (assessable vs occluded absence; correct-count vs fragmentation decoy).

clarification_expected.description: True when the correct behaviour is to ask one focused clarification (e.g. long-gap identity, open-world negation).
